name: realtime-whiteboard
description: Real-time collaborative whiteboard (simplified Miro/Excalidraw) built on Yjs CRDTs.

scripts.kill:dev: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ports = 5173,1234; foreach ($p in $ports) { $conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($conns) { $conns | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } }"
scripts.build: npm --workspace @whiteboard/server run build && npm --workspace @whiteboard/client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @whiteboard/server run typecheck && npm --workspace @whiteboard/client run typecheck
